svg.title: WP-V-08 Figure 4-1: ODD coverage of the scenarios
svg.desc: Matrix of 26 scenarios against the 20 ODD attributes of WP-C-02. Scenarios per attribute: ODD-01 Area 1; ODD-02 Road type 4; ODD-03 Posted speed limit 3; ODD-04 Junctions 8; ODD-05 Crossings 5; ODD-06 Road surface and geometry 3; ODD-07 Lane markings 2; ODD-08 Temporary changes 2; ODD-09 Stopping places 3; ODD-10 Precipitation 4; ODD-11 Visibility 2; ODD-12 Illumination 12; ODD-13 Road surface condition 6; ODD-14 Temperature 1; ODD-15 Connectivity 5; ODD-16 Traffic participants 17; ODD-17 Traffic density 8; ODD-18 Special vehicles 2; ODD-19 Traffic direction by people 1; ODD-20 Ego speed 20. Across the boundary: SC-10 on ODD-07, ODD-08; SC-11 on ODD-19; SC-14 on ODD-10, ODD-11; SC-20 on ODD-15. Every ODD attribute is varied.
svg.text: Which ODD conditions each scenario varies
WP-V-08 §4: a filled cell is an ODD attribute (WP-C-02 §3) the scenario
sweeps; a red outline marks a sweep across the ODD boundary
